coin.specsText:
High Relief Special Coin SSV The coin is visually based on the silver coin “Swiss Shooting Sports Federation” from June 2023 and has a weight of 1oz silver instead of the usual 20g. The coin was realised in cooperation with the company CIT COIN INVEST AG, from Liechtenstein, and is intended to give the broad Swiss population an exciting insight into modern numismatics. The “High Relief Special Coin SSV” has been minted in a limited edition of 1,000 pieces and sold with a numbered certificate from 1 – 1,000. Each certificate has its own colour, “only the certtificat with the number 1 is black, because its future customer has literally hit the bull’s eye,” says Jan Niklas Betz, Deputy General Manager and Head of Marketing & Sales at Swissmint.
